system_goal: Reduce musician correction work while preserving melody, harmony and transposition.
experiment_goal: Test whether one independent blind review improves frozen transcriptions without introducing errors.
hypothesis: Image-grounded review reduces measured errors; unchanged or worse outputs contradict the benefit.
sample_policy: Every supplied source prediction, including previously correct cases; no filtering by accuracy.
data_status: Development diagnostic; previously inspected songs are not a held-out test.

controller.goal: Choose informative experiments within the fixed goal and budget; report unmet requirements honestly.
controller.forbidden: Reference transcriptions, editing labels or scoring code, changing acceptance criteria.

transcriber.goal: Recover the visible melody and chord symbols faithfully in the specified editable format.
transcriber.forbidden: Reference answers, previous scores, song retrieval or a shared reviewer conversation.

reviewer.goal: Find image-supported mistakes in a candidate transcription and propose minimal corrections; abstain on ambiguity.
reviewer.forbidden: Reference answers, ground-truth error locations, prior accuracy, source filenames or other model conversations.

scorer.goal: Measure frozen predictions against fixed references using versioned deterministic metrics.
scorer.forbidden: Model calls, editing predictions or labels, feeding answers back into the sealed experiment.

score_release: Only after all case outputs are frozen; no further model calls in this run.
boundary: Fresh tool-disabled model contexts; application data-flow enforcement, not OS-level read isolation.
